provenance.invariant: An all-day weekly series and an all-day modified occurrence: the master anchors on VALUE=DATE with no VTIMEZONE, and the override carries RECURRENCE-ID;VALUE=DATE — the all-day RECURRENCE-ID form, resolved to the calendar day in the event zone even though agenda identifies the occurrence by an instant.
